questions.question: The post and both author’s illustrations use “Zed is dead”, while the cited screenplay uses “Zed’s dead”. Decide whether to preserve the author’s wording as part of the joke or standardise the exact film quotation.

localizations.source: The post and both author’s illustrations use “Zed is dead”, while the cited screenplay uses “Zed’s dead”. Decide whether to preserve the author’s wording as part of the joke or standardise the exact film quotation.
localizations.ru: В посте и на обеих авторских иллюстрациях реплика дана как «Zed is dead», а в приведённом сценарии — «Zed’s dead». Решить, сохранять ли авторский вариант как часть шутки или унифицировать точную киноцитату.

questions.resolution: The author’s wording “Zed is dead” is retained as a deliberate adaptation that makes the pun on coordinate Z explicit. The note distinguishes it from the screenplay line, “Zed’s dead, baby, Zed’s dead.”

questions.question: The text closely follows S. N. Fedin’s anecdote 32, yet authorship and the root rights_basis are assigned entirely to Mansur Gilmullin. Distinguish the source text’s authorship from Mansur’s adaptation and illustration work.

localizations.source: The text closely follows S. N. Fedin’s anecdote 32, yet authorship and the root rights_basis are assigned entirely to Mansur Gilmullin. Distinguish the source text’s authorship from Mansur’s adaptation and illustration work.
localizations.ru: Текст близко следует анекдоту 32 С. Н. Федина, но авторство и корневой rights_basis целиком отданы Мансуру Гильмуллину. Нужно развести авторство исходного текста и вклад Мансура — адаптацию и иллюстрацию.

questions.resolution: The editors accepted the reviewed version for publication. See https://github.com/Fuzzy-Technologies/history_math/pull/606#pullrequestreview-6040167991

questions.question: The label “author’s illustration” and the entry “Mansur Gilmullin’s archive” establish file custody, but do not identify the image creator, rightsholder, public source, or licence. Before publication, provide those details or remove the unsupported authorship claim.
